item.title: September 23rd Cognitive Science Seminar with Dr. Sanjay Oruganti
item.description: Please join the Cognitive Science Department on Wednesday, September 23rd, for a presentation by Dr. Sanjay Oruganti, Research Scientist in the Language, Embodiment, Intelligence, Agency (LEIA) Lab in the Cognitive Science Department at RPI. The presentation is titled “Why Cognitive Robotics Matters: Lessons from OntoAgent and LLM Deployment in HARMONIC for Safety-Critical Robot Teaming.”

item.title: Getting the Most from Percipio : “Assigning Learning in Percipio: A Guide for Supervisors:”
item.description: This course provides supervisors with a step-by-step overview of how to assign learning content to employees using Percipio. You’ll learn how to search for relevant courses, create and manage assignments, track completion, and support your team’s development goals. Designed to be quick and practical, this session equips you with the tools needed to guide your team’s learning journey effectively.
item.author: Faculty and Staff

item.title: RPI Faculty and Staff Webinar - Strategies on Flipping Your Classroom
item.description:
Date: Monday, October 5, 2026 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM - This session will discuss the practice of moving traditional in-class lectures onto the web by creating engaging, media-rich content that student’s access before, during, or after class. Class time is refocused, allowing students to work on tasks and problems that apply the concepts they studied independently. Please register using the Event URL in the See section of the calendar event.
